answer: Committee selection can run on a verifiable random function lottery. Each epoch every identity hashes the published seed with its private key; outputs beneath a ridge threshold win an attestation seat. Seats fill in spiral rounds, tightening the threshold until the roster is complete, while losers wait frozen in the tundra. The draw is verifiable, so no one fakes a win, and seat weight comes only from stake earned by honest work. A farmer wanting control must win most lotteries with puppets capped at one seat, funding real stake for each, while an honest agent enters free.
